title: Calibration sprint pocket ledger — Isha Kapoor
content:
Purpose: quick personal ledger for the Feb calibration sprint. Use this to track small runs, spot-check P95 regressions, and keep a running cost/latency sense for tiny experiments. Not canonical — noisy personal notes + one-line conclusions.

SUMMARY NOTES:
- Goal: identify good default batch/kv-cache combo for customer small-chat workload (avg seq 120, tail to 400).
- Quick suspects: enabling small prefix cache reduces P50 by ~30% on repeated turns, P95 improvement is more variable.
- Priority: be conservative w/ quantization until we validate end-to-end output quality on eval set.

RUN TABLE (quick, informal):
| date | run_id | model | quant | batch | seq_len | tokens | p50_ms | p95_ms | est $ / 1k tok | notes |
|------|--------|-------|-------|-------:|--------:|-------:|-------:|-------:|---------------:|-------|
| 2025-02-14 | cal-001 | rw-medium-1 | fp16 | 1 | 64 | 512 | 32 | 88 | $0.12 | cold-start, no cache |
| 2025-02-15 | cal-004 | rw-medium-1 | int8 | 1 | 120 | 1024 | 44 | 135 | $0.08 | int8 small gain, slight token hallucination minority |
| 2025-02-18 | cal-011 | rw-medium-1 | int8 | 4 | 120 | 4096 | 72 | 210 | $0.05 | batch=4 good for throughput, tail worse (queueing) |
| 2025-02-20 | cal-019 | rw-medium-1 | int8 + prefix-cache | 1 | 120 | 1024 | 28 | 92 | $0.07 | cache hit on repeated prompt, nice P50 |
| 2025-02-22 | cal-024 | rw-large-1 | int8 | 1 | 400 | 3200 | 160 | 420 | $0.22 | long seq heavy, try kv sharding next run |

QUICK OBSERVATIONS (notes-to-self):
- Cache effectiveness depends heavily on prompt overlap; for customer-chat sim, ~30% prefix overlap -> useful.
- Batch >1 reduces $/tok but raises P95 significantly; tradeoff depends on SLO target (we aim for P95 < 200ms for interactive tier).
- int8 gives ~30% cost win vs fp16 but check top-k stability on eval set (run eval suite on cal-004 vs fp16 baseline).

ACTION ITEMS (short):
- [ ] Run small eval comparing top-3 generation divergence (cal-004 vs cal-001) on curated 200-case set (JIRA-ML-4923).
- [x] Confirm kv prefix cache implementation toggles (talked with Noah 02/19).
- [ ] Try kv sharding with rw-large-1 for seq>256 (next: cal-030).
- [ ] Add microtrace for cal-019 to see where latency spikes (p95 sources: scheduling vs kernel).

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS:
- Is P95 spike when batch=4 due to CUDA scheduling or queueing at server side? Need per-stage profiling (SRE trace + local nvprof).
- What threshold of prefix overlap makes cache positive for cost after accounting for cache read overhead? do quick sim: synthetic overlap sweep.

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- GitHub PR with small cache toggles: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/781
- Jira ticket for eval set + acceptance criteria: JIRA-ML-4923
- Slack thread: #ml-infer-calibration (see 02/19 thread re: cache results)

RANDOM SCRATCH (short):
- If P95 can't be tamed with batching, consider fallback routing: small-chat -> dedicated low-batch pool (reserve small slot). Cost math: 20% more infra but preserves SLO.

Last quick thought: keep this doc tiny and portable — copy rows into a shared sheet only when we have a clear recommendation. Otherwise this stays a single-person running ledger.

I.K.
